title: Affine-projection normalization of the local diagonal DNC composite
statement: Fix P, a Noetherian finite-type k-scheme Y, d≥0 and the smooth ordered affine projection p:A^d_Y→Y. On any affine target open V, let E be any normalized DNC Chart. For every normalized finite twist transport t and P1 datum family D, localInverse(P,p,V,E).hom equals the pullback to p^{-1}V of nu*(diagonalAffineMate(t,D,Y,d)). No general smooth f or etale coordinate neighbourhood is a parameter.

proof.text: Construct S by the actual affine counit over the local source B. Its coordinate isomorphism is proved from the two pullback universal properties.
The DNC and normal-purity equation says S delta beta = identity. Cancel the isomorphism delta followed by beta to obtain beta inverse followed by delta inverse = S.

Expand localInverse as tate followed by beta inverse, delta inverse, alpha, rho inverse and coefficient unit change. Substitute the preceding equality, then the trace base-change equation. The adjacent Tate inverse maps cancel, giving the required restriction of the actual counit mate.

theorem diagonalDncAffineModel (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u})
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian Y] (d : ℕ)
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d (affineTraceProjection Y d)]
    (aY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k)) [LocallyOfFiniteType aY] [QuasiCompact aY]
    (V : Y.affineOpens)
    (E : OrientationRefinement.Chart P (affineTraceProjection Y d) aY d V)
    (t : Etale.OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport P.Coefficient P.diagonalExponent
      P.diagonalExponent_annihilates)
    (D : ∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian T]
      (hT : IsUnit (P.diagonalExponent : Γ(T, ⊤))),
      Etale.OrdinaryFiniteP1Datum P.Coefficient P.diagonalExponent
        P.diagonalExponent_annihilates t T hT) :
    let ν := (ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar
      (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient) (affineTraceTower Y d)).mapDerivedCategory
    (OrientationCounit.localInverse P d (affineTraceProjection Y d) aY V E).hom =
      (OrientationRefinement.pull P ((affineTraceProjection Y d) ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).ι).map
        (ν.map (P.diagonalAffineMate t D Y (P.diagonalExponent_isUnit aY) d))
